Superside is looking for a motion designer with the creativity, technical expertise, and innovation mindset to push the boundaries of motion design. You’ll work with top global brands, crafting high-impact motion graphics, animated digital ads, Lottie animations, and more, all while collaborating with a world-class, globally distributed team of creatives.
 
 
 
This is a high-ownership role where you’ll contribute to cutting-edge projects, explore new animation technologies, and help shape Superside’s creative motion capabilities.

jobs.title: Creative Strategist (Performance Studio)
jobs.description: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Studio to connect media, audience intelligence, creative strategy, and performance data into smarter creative decisions. Working closely with the General Manager of our new Performance Business Unit, you'll help build this capability from 0 to 1, turning performance signals into clear hypotheses, testing agendas, and briefs that creative teams can act on. You'll need to understand how modern paid media works, find the creative story inside the data, and help make every round of creative stronger than the last.

jobs.title: Director of Creative Strategy
jobs.description:
Superside is hiring a Director of Creative Strategy to lead and evolve our Strategy function. You'll shape how strategy drives creative excellence across the business, leading a team of strategists while partnering with executive customers and internal leaders to solve complex business challenges through insight-driven creativity.
You'll define the future of strategy at Superside, building scalable frameworks, growing strategic talent, and ensuring strategy becomes a key driver of customer success, creative quality, and commercial growth.

jobs.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
jobs.description:
Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Superside is looking for Project Managers to strengthen our team. You will craft and execute creative strategies and assets for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies. All of this while working in a global remote community focused on shaping the future of creative work.


In this role, you’ll take ownership of key accounts from day one, navigate a steep learning curve, and embark on an exciting journey that embraces innovation and AI for creativity.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Superside is hiring a Senior Creative Strategist to turn insights into breakthrough creative work. You'll partner with enterprise customers and multidisciplinary creative teams to develop insight-driven strategies across brand, digital, social, and web experiences.
You'll combine analytical thinking with creative intuition, helping shape campaigns that deliver measurable business results while contributing to the continued evolution of strategy at Superside.
